_about: Issue #575. Migrations at or before these nodes predate the expand/contract rule and are not checked by tarmar_studio/tests/test_migration_safety.py. Every migration after them must leave the previous release working against the new schema, or be listed in allowed with the reason it is a deliberate contract step. Move the baseline forward only by hand, and never past a migration that has not yet been deployed.

allowed.gm.0019_drop_retired_supplies_column: Issue #623, the contract half of #575's rule. CampaignState.supplies has been read by nothing since gm.0018_supply_items, which shipped to production in 0244f8e on 2026-09-21; fadcee9 has shipped since, and both the serving colour and the rollback target run code that does not select the column.
